screenshots.name: wh-procurement-list
screenshots.description: Procurement request history tab showing table with priority badges, status columns, and totals
screenshots.desiredState: Procurement page fully loaded with the Request History tab active. Table shows request rows with columns: request number, date, requester, priority badge (normal/urgent/critical), status, and total value.
screenshots.differentiator: Shows the procurement request history list — not the analytics tab, not the pending approval tab, not the creation modal

mustShow: Request table rows or empty state

screenshots.name: wh-procurement-create
screenshots.description: Procurement request creation modal with multi-section form for items, quantities, and priority selection
screenshots.desiredState: Procurement creation modal is open showing form fields: date, request number, requester department, priority selector, supplier dropdown, and line items section for adding products.
screenshots.differentiator: Shows the procurement creation form as a modal overlay — not the request history list

stateSetup.description: Click the New Request button in the page header to open the creation modal

interactionSequence.script: (() => { var btns = document.querySelectorAll('button'); for (var b of btns) { var rect = b.getBoundingClientRect(); if (rect.top < 120 && b.textContent.trim().length > 0 && rect.width > 80) { b.click(); return 'clicked header action button'; } } return 'no button found'; })()

screenshots.knownLimitation: The New Request button selector may need adjustment based on actual DOM structure.

mustNotShow: Only the list page without modal

screenshots.name: wh-procurement-approval
screenshots.description: Pending approval tab showing procurement requests awaiting review with approve and reject action buttons
screenshots.desiredState: Procurement page with the Pending Approval tab active. Shows requests awaiting authorization with action buttons for approve and reject.
screenshots.differentiator: Shows the pending approval tab — not the request history tab, not the analytics tab

stateSetup.description: Navigate to procurement page and click the Pending Approval tab

interactionSequence.script: (() => { var tabs = document.querySelectorAll('[role="tab"]'); if (tabs.length >= 3) { tabs[2].click(); return 'clicked third tab (pending approval)'; } if (tabs.length >= 2) { tabs[tabs.length - 1].click(); return 'clicked last tab'; } return 'tabs not found, count: ' + tabs.length; })()

screenshots.knownLimitation: If no pending requests exist, an empty state will be shown. The orange badge count depends on live data.

mustShow: Request rows with action buttons or empty state

screenshots.name: wh-procurement-detail
screenshots.description: Procurement request detail modal showing read-only view with line items, approval history, and status timeline
screenshots.desiredState: Detail modal is open showing a read-only view of a procurement request. Displays all line items with quantities and prices, approval history with timestamps, and the current status in a timeline or badge.
screenshots.differentiator: Shows the detail/read-only modal for an existing request — not the creation modal, not the list page

stateSetup.description: Navigate to procurement page and click a table row to open the detail modal

interactionSequence.script: (() => { var rows = document.querySelectorAll('table tbody tr, [class*="TableRow"], [class*="table-row"]'); if (rows.length > 0) { rows[0].click(); return 'clicked first table row'; } return 'no table rows found'; })()

screenshots.knownLimitation: Requires at least one procurement request in the table. If the table is empty, no detail modal can be opened.

mustNotShow: Only the list page without modal
